query: Write the press release for MCR-273 — we're announcing the launch of Facilitron Tickets, our new online box-office and event-ticketing product for school districts.
expected_behavior: Pulls the announcement details from the Jira ticket via acli and any linked Confluence brief via tron:confluence

Sources the approved About Facilitron boilerplate and media-contact line from the press kit (or falls back to the standing default and flags it for confirmation) so the only real gaps left are approved quotes
Drafts in standard AP-style PR structure: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE, headline, subhead, dateline lead paragraph (inverted pyramid), body with quotes, About Facilitron boilerplate, and Media Contact
Does not fabricate quotes or numbers — marks missing exec/customer quotes with > TODO: and uses AskUserQuestion for the few facts that matter
Produces copy with no em dashes (Facilitron voice), third person, no marketing superlatives in the body

Publishes the draft to the preselected Drive or Confluence destination, returns review and owner metadata, stays git-free, and offers the durable URL to tron:grill, tron:md-to-pdf, or a worktree-first handoff to the bare repo-local news-item skill
